message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. In most cases the complaint is handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** (APD) and/or the **City of Atlanta’s 311 Service**. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where/How | |------|------------|-----------| | **1** | Identify the source of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). | Gather details: time, location, description, and any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | | **2** | Contact the **Atlanta Police Department**. | • Phone: **(404) 656‑4000** (non‑emergency line)
• Online: Use the APD’s “Report a Crime” portal at https://www.atlantapd.org/report-a-crime | | **3** | Alternatively, use the **City of Atlanta 311** system. | • Phone: **(404) 656‑3111**
• Online: https://311.atlantaga.gov/ | | **4** | If the noise is from a commercial property, you can also file a complaint with the **Atlanta Office of the Inspector General** (for violations of the city’s noise ordinance). | • Phone: **(404) 656‑4000** (same as APD)
• Online: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/inspector-general | | **5** | For ongoing or repeated disturbances, consider filing a formal written complaint. | • Submit a written notice to the property owner or landlord.
• Keep copies of all correspondence. | ### Key Points to Remember - **Noise Ordinance Hours:** Most residential areas prohibit loud noises between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. on weekdays, and 11 p.m. to 8 a.m. on weekends. Commercial zones may have different hours. - **Evidence Helps:** Photos, videos, or audio recordings of the disturbance strengthen your complaint. - **Follow Up:** If the issue isn’t resolved after the initial complaint, you can follow up with the APD or 311. Keep a record of your complaint number and any responses received. - **Local Council Role:** While the City Council sets ordinances, they don’t typically handle individual noise complaints. That responsibility lies with the APD and the city’s administrative offices. ### Quick Links - **Atlanta Police Department – Report a Crime Portal:** https://www.atlantapd.org/report-a-crime - **City of Atlanta 311 Portal:** https://311.atlantaga.gov/ - **Atlanta City Hall – Noise Ordinance Information:** https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-hall/ordinances/noise-ordinance If you’re unsure which agency to contact, start with the APD’s non‑emergency line or the 311 service—they’ll direct you to the appropriate department.
